results.title: Nosferatu
results.overview: Nosferatu arrives in a town escaping from Van Helsing. He brings not only his curse, but ghosts from his past. In this escape, he dives into a macabre dance searching for an actress and faces the horror of eternity and the pain of an endless existence.

results.title: Ordinary Girl in a Tiara
results.overview: When vintage fashion devotee Caro Cartwright agrees to harbor her childhood nemesis turned couture heiress Philippa Levreaux, fireworks explode.

results.title: Pace Yourself
results.overview: Jo works at the same bar since graduating college and as her friends seem to be moving forward in life, Jo feels stuck. Things get complicated when her ex-boyfriend, Patrick, moves back to town after the two haven’t spoken in months. The two must confront their lingering feelings as they try and navigate what they want, personally and professionally, but that isn't is easy it seems.

results.title: Another Sweet Christmas
results.overview: When Sophie and Sam’s picture-perfect love story is transformed into a Christmas movie, their hometown of Waynesbridge, Washington, becomes a dazzling holiday film set. But as the spotlight grows brighter real-life challenges soon follow. As they navigate the pressures of expectation, will Sophie and Sam’s real-life wedding have to be re-written? Only they can answer the question every great love story faces: what lasts when the cameras stop rolling?

results.title: Selenolatry
results.overview: A young woman, Layla Ford, is trying to make amends for her past mistakes, but her recovery is halted by the presence of a curse.

results.title: You Stole My Heart
results.overview: After robbing a bank, young engineer Eric tricks his dating app fling Vera into becoming his driver in his flight from Madrid to Galicia.

results.title: Les Condés
results.overview: In Marseille, the National Police are at their wits' end! The Interior Minister decides to create a squad of "super-cops," offering huge salaries to maximize applicant interest. The very next day, an endless line of unlikely candidates forms outside the city's police stations. Among the recruits selected are a compulsive liar, a man deep in debt, a conspiracy theorist, a wannabe rapper, and a racist. What if these future officers turned out to be the Police Academy's best hope?

results.overview: Some parents experience the anguish of the "empty nest" when their children leave home. Javier, on the other hand, suffers the trauma of the "full nest": no one wants to leave home.

results.title: Lucky Star
results.overview: In 1940, in France, Jean Chevalin lives with his family in great poverty after deserting the army. Convinced that some people manage better than others, he decides to pretend to be Jewish in order to receive help from smugglers and reach the free zone. This ruse will lead his family on a journey that will gradually dismantle his prejudices.

results.title: Verified Target
results.overview: When a bad person is marked as a 'virus', they become a verified target and will be terminated. A unique team of assassins known as 'AVL' follows this strict code. But when Blake discovers her target is innocent, she uncovers a bigger conspiracy. To hide their corruption, members of the AVL mark her as a Verified Target.

results.title: That Summer in Paris
results.overview: Paris, the 2024 Olympic Games. Blandine (30) arrives from Normandy to watch the swimming competitions. Disorientated by the hustle and bustle of the city where nothing seems to go her way, she navigates the chaos of Paris and an unexpected reunion.

results.title: Escobank
results.overview: A ragtag group of misfits, veterans and ex-cons embark on a perilous journey in the jungles of Colombia to find the buried barrels of cash left behind by legendary drug kingpin Pablo Escobar before his downfall.

results.title: Salvo Di Paola: Lorem Ipsum
results.overview: Lorem Ipsum tells the story of a press officer who, faced with a metafictional synopsis, is unsure what to make of it, so he asks the show's author for comment, who quotes him verbatim:  "Lorem Ipsum is my second stand-up comedy monologue. And I'm not sure what it's about. I think it's about thinking. More specifically, I think it's about what you think when you talk about what you think. Or more simply, I think it's about nothing."

results.title: Natacha, (Almost) Air Hostess
results.overview: France, 1963. Since she was a child, Natacha has dreamed of freedom and adventure. Her dream has a name: air hostess. She admires the women who fly the world, with no ties, no husbands, and no cooking to do. Despite all her efforts Natacha does not match the walking fantasy that an air hostess is supposed to embody at the time. She's too... or not enough... whatever it is, she hasn't got it!

results.overview: A college student seeks help from his friend after encountering a horrific and mentally challenging vision
